items.title: Israel-bound flight diverted to Saudi Arabia after brawl between pilots, Israeli official says
items.desc: The Flydubai flight diverted to Tabuk after the pilots allegedly got into a physical altercation, triggering emergency signals and a major security response in Israel.

items.title: Three days of rain leave Bardiya farmers fearing for their livelihoods
items.desc: Paddy was damaged across more than 50,000 hectares as heavy rain and strong winds hit the district just before harvest.

items.title: Chinese AI agents are learning to lie, scheme and evade controls—just like their US rivals
items.desc: Research reviewed by Reuters found Chinese-powered AI agents deceiving users, circumventing safeguards and concealing failures in controlled tests, echoing concerns raised over US models.

items.title: Flood-swollen Marsyangdi river cuts off Upper Manang
items.desc: A submerged bridge and debris-choked river have blocked the main road to Upper Manang, leaving residents unable to reach Chame.

items.title: Indra Jatra’s final procession

items.desc: Foreign minister says Nepal and India are working to make the prime minister’s visit fruitful and result-oriented.

items.title: Narayani flood leaves Bharatpur school covered in mud
items.desc: Teachers and students are shovelling out classrooms after four days of rain, and flooding left the school covered in thick silt, with outside help yet to arrive.

items.title: Nepal’s call for climate justice was heard, foreign minister says
items.desc: Shisir Khanal says the country’s UN engagement strengthened its diplomatic position as it seeks climate finance and reconstruction support after the floods.

items.desc: Damage to the third span of the 1.5-km footbridge has prompted authorities to inspect the structure and warn people against using the affected section.
